method: Built-in image_gen; transparent 4x4 sprite sheets; fennec sprite and rescue poster edited from the existing game art; technical extraction and resizing via Sharp

animals.panda: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production sprite animation sheet for cute isometric mobile garden game. Reference image is style only, replace corgi with an ORIGINAL baby black-and-white PANDA, animal on all four legs, no clothing. Soft polished 3D storybook rendering, expressive eyes, rounded body, clean readable silhouette. Transparent background. Square 2048x2048 sheet, EXACT 4 columns x 4 rows equal square cells, one complete panda per cell, no dividers no text. Each panda fully inside its own cell with generous transparent margins, same camera, consistent anatomy and scale, paws anchored same baseline. Row 1 FRONT three-quarter facing screen-right: neutral idle, slightly curious, blink, open-mouth yawn. Row 2 FRONT same camera: curled sleeping, front-paw stretch, walking pose A, walking pose B. Row 3 FRONT walking pose C, walking pose D; then REAR three-quarter facing away screen-right neutral, rear walk A. Row 4 REAR walk B, rear walk C, rear walk D, rear idle. True rear views show back of head and rump. Tiny short panda tail. Consistent same baby panda all 16 frames, plush white fur and deep charcoal ears/limbs/eye patches. No floor, no grass, no props, no glow, no shadow outside silhouette. Preserve real alpha transparency.
animals.fox: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production 4×4 transparent sprite sheet for the Cloud Garden isometric mobile game. Input Image 1 is the exact existing fox sheet, used for the pose order, isometric camera, framing, and polished 3D storybook style. Replace the woodland fox in all sixteen cells with the same baby FENNEC FOX. Give it unmistakably oversized, tall, wide ears with pale cream rims and warm dusty-peach inner ears, fine pale golden-sand beige fur, an ivory muzzle, cheeks and chest, glossy warm dark-brown eyes, a small black nose, light sand-colored paws and a modest fluffy low-curving sand-colored tail with a soft charcoal tip. Keep it a compact baby quadruped. No clothes, props, outline, floor, cast shadow, color speckles, text, divider, decoration or watermark. Use true transparent alpha on every area outside the animals. Match a soft, rounded collectible game character with fine plush fur and a slightly top-down 3/4 view. Keep EXACTLY four columns and four rows of perfectly equal square cells; one full-body fennec entirely inside each cell with at least 6% transparent margins on all four sides, even above ear tips. Keep proportions, light, scale and eye identity consistent. Each frame faces screen-right. Row 1: front three-quarter idle, curious, blink, yawn. Row 2: curled sleep, forepaw stretch, front walk poses A and B. Row 3: front walk C and D, then real rear three-quarter idle, then rear walk A. Row 4: rear walk B, C, D, rear idle. Match the corresponding foot poses and play-ready flower garden illustration style. In rear views, show the back of the head and rump without visible eye or face. Square sheet.

poster: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the exact illustrated Cloud Garden rescue event poster to edit. Image 2 is the character model reference for the new baby fennec, for appearance only. In Image 1, edit only the small orange woodland fox on the mossy log, between the black-and-white panda and the red panda cub, slightly right of center. Replace that one small character with Image 2's baby FENNEC FOX, with distinctive tall oversized ears, peach inner ears, pale golden-sand fur, ivory cheeks and chest, warm brown eyes, light paws and a low-curving fluffy tail with a charcoal tip. Match the fox's existing position, small scale, leftward gaze toward Lumi, and walking pose with a lifted forepaw. Ground its paws on the log, matching perspective, golden rim light, and natural contact shadow. Keep the existing widescreen 3:2 crop, artwork style, and composition. Preserve Lumi on the left with exactly the same teal overalls and scarf, the baby panda and red panda on the bridge, and the original stream, forest, arch, path, flowers, and lighting. Maintain the storybook finish and every detail outside the small fox replacement. Opaque landscape poster, full bleed. No text, logos, border or new objects.
